description: Structured eval definitions for the EventBridge Scheduler Deployer. Five-case proven set exercising the READY_TO_DEPLOY / PREREQUISITES_MISSING classification across scheduler topologies (Lambda rate schedule with flexible time window OFF, Step Functions cron schedule with timezone and DLQ, SNS one-time schedule with retry policy, schedule group bulk operations, missing target IAM role prerequisite failure). Each eval maps to a prompt file and a baseline (no-skill) file for with-skill-vs-baseline comparison.

eval_cases.name: Lambda rate schedule with flexible time window OFF and constant JSON input
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — rate(1 hour), Lambda target, flexible time window OFF (exact-time), constant JSON input, Scheduler-managed IAM role
eval_cases.prompt: Create an EventBridge Scheduler schedule called hourly-report that invokes Lambda function report-generator (arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:report-generator) every 1 hour. Flexible time window OFF (exact-time invocation). Pass constant JSON input: {"report_type": "hourly", "env": "prod"}. Schedule group: prod-schedules. Tags: Environment=production, Team=data.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SCHEDULER: hourly-report (rate(1 hour))
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Schedule name: hourly-report
  [✓] Schedule type: rate
  [✓] Expression: rate(1 hour) (timezone: UTC)
  [✓] Flexible time window: OFF (exact-time invocation)
  [✓] Target: Lambda — arn:aws:lambda:us-east-1:123456789012:function:report-generator
  [✓] IAM role: Scheduler-managed (auto-scoped to target ARN)
  [✓] Target input: {"report_type": "hourly", "env": "prod"}
  [✓] Schedule group: prod-schedules
  [✓] State: ENABLED
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production, Team=data
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws scheduler get-schedule --name hourly-report --group-name prod-schedules --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Step Functions cron schedule with timezone, DLQ, and retry policy
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — cron(0 9 ? * MON-FRI *), Step Functions target, America/New_York timezone, DLQ configured, retry max 3
eval_cases.prompt: Create an EventBridge Scheduler schedule called weekday-etl that triggers Step Functions state machine etl-pipeline (arn:aws:states:us-east-1:123456789012:stateMachine:etl-pipeline) at 9 AM weekdays, US Eastern timezone. DLQ: arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:scheduler-dlq. Retry: max 3 attempts, max event age 3600 seconds. Tags: Environment=production, Team=data.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SCHEDULER: weekday-etl (cron(0 9 ? * MON-FRI *))
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Schedule name: weekday-etl
  [✓] Schedule type: cron
  [✓] Expression: cron(0 9 ? * MON-FRI *) (timezone: America/New_York)
  [✓] Flexible time window: OFF
  [✓] Target: Step Functions — etl-pipeline
  [✓] IAM role: Scheduler-managed
  [✓] Retry policy: max 3 attempts, max age 3600s
  [✓] Dead-letter queue: arn:aws:sqs:us-east-1:123456789012:scheduler-dlq
  [✓] State: ENABLED
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws scheduler get-schedule --name weekday-etl --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: SNS one-time schedule with retry policy and auto-delete
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — one-time at(2026-09-01T14:00:00), SNS target, auto-delete after completion, retry max 5
eval_cases.prompt: Create a one-time EventBridge Scheduler schedule called campaign-launch that publishes to SNS topic marketing-alerts (arn:aws:sns:us-east-1:123456789012:marketing-alerts) at 2026-09-01T14:00:00 UTC. Auto-delete after completion. Retry: max 5 attempts. Pass input {"campaign": "summer-sale"}. Tags: Environment=production, Team=marketing.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SCHEDULER: campaign-launch (at(2026-09-01T14:00:00))
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Schedule name: campaign-launch
  [✓] Schedule type: one-time
  [✓] Expression: at(2026-09-01T14:00:00) (timezone: UTC)
  [✓] Target: SNS — marketing-alerts
  [✓] IAM role: Scheduler-managed
  [✓] Retry policy: max 5 attempts
  [✓] Delete after completion: true
  [✓] State: ENABLED
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws scheduler get-schedule --name campaign-launch --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Schedule group with bulk operations and flexible time window MAXIMUM
eval_cases.branch: READY_TO_DEPLOY — group creation, two schedules with MAXIMUM flexible time window (cost optimization), bulk enable/disable capability noted
eval_cases.prompt: Create an EventBridge Scheduler schedule group called maintenance-jobs in us-east-1, account 123456789012. Add two schedules to the group: daily-cleanup (rate(1 day)) targeting Lambda cleanup-function and weekly-audit (cron(0 0 ? * SUN *)) targeting Lambda audit-function. Flexible time window MAXIMUM for both (cost optimization). Tags: Environment=production.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SCHEDULER: maintenance-jobs (group)
VERDICT: READY_TO_DEPLOY
CHECKLIST:
  [✓] Schedule group: maintenance-jobs
  [✓] Schedule: daily-cleanup (rate(1 day)) — MAXIMUM flexible window
  [✓] Schedule: weekly-audit (cron(0 0 ? * SUN *)) — MAXIMUM flexible window
  [✓] IAM role: Scheduler-managed per schedule
  [✓] Bulk operations: enable/disable all via group state
  [✓] Tags: Environment=production
VERIFICATION_COMMANDS:
  aws scheduler list-schedules --group-name maintenance-jobs --region us-east-1

eval_cases.name: Schedule with missing target and missing iam:PassRole (prerequisite failure)
eval_cases.branch: PREREQUISITES_MISSING — target Lambda function does not exist AND caller lacks iam:PassRole
eval_cases.prompt: Create an EventBridge Scheduler schedule called my-job that invokes Lambda function nonexistent-function every 5 minutes. The function does not exist. Also, the caller does not have iam:PassRole permission.
eval_cases.expected_output:
SCHEDULER: my-job
VERDICT: PREREQUISITES_MISSING
CHECKLIST:
  [✗] Target: nonexistent-function — Lambda function does not exist
  [✗] IAM role: caller lacks iam:PassRole — Scheduler cannot assume its managed role
